annotations.title: Apply a Style / re-roll a deck's design

description: Apply a Style to an existing deck, or redraw its current one — WITHOUT touching a word of its copy or regenerating a single image. By default this RE-ROLLS: every slide is rebuilt from its own content with the new Style and/or a new seed, so composition, positions, crops, alignment, motion, framing, type and colour all change. This is the intended way to apply a Style — a Style changes everything except the text and the images, not only the palette. The text, the images, the speaker notes and each slide's layout ARCHETYPE are pinned, so it costs nothing to run and can be repeated freely. Pass `adjustOnly: true` for the old patch-in-place behaviour: repaint palette/type/decor onto the existing composition and keep every hand-positioned element where it is (no layout, motion or crop change). Omit styleId to redraw with the deck's current Style; pass a seed to make the draw reproducible.

adjustOnly.description: Keep the composition: repaint colour/type/decor in place instead of re-rolling layout. Requires a styleId. Preserves hand-positioned elements.

includeLocked.description: Redraw locked slides too (default false). A slide comes back locked only from a PPTX import — its layout is not lorem's own, so a bare re-roll leaves it exactly as imported and reports it as skipped with reason "locked-import". Pass true to redraw it: an imported slide is relaid out onto the new Style, carrying every word and every picture. A slide holding something the new layout has no place for — a table, a chart, a drawing, a second picture — is kept exactly as imported instead, and the response says which.

seed.description: Reproducible draw; the same seed gives the same design.

styleId.description: A Style id from list_styles. Omit to redraw with the deck's current Style.
